ai.literal: Worthy of the home, excellence she who possesses having become, her own he who took's wealth she who is suited to, is life's companion.
ai.translation: A true life companion is one who possesses the excellence worthy of family life and adapts herself to her husband's means.
ai.modern: குடும்ப வாழ்விற்கு ஏற்ற நற்பண்புகளை உடையவளாகி, தன்னை மனைவியாக ஏற்ற கணவனின் வருவாய்க்கு ஏற்ப வாழ்பவளே சிறந்த வாழ்க்கைத்துணை ஆவாள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ideal qualities of a life companion. The phrase 'மனைத்தக்க மாண்பு' refers to the moral excellence and virtues required to maintain a harmonious household. Furthermore, 'வளத்தக்காள்' emphasizes the practical wisdom of managing the home according to the husband's financial resources. Together, these traits of virtuous character and financial prudence make a spouse a true partner in life.

ai.literal: Household excellence with the wife if it is not, life, of whatever greatness even if it is, is nothing.
ai.translation: If a wife lacks the excellence needed to manage a household, domestic life is nothing, no matter how great it may be in other ways.
ai.modern: மனைவியிடம் குடும்பத்திற்குத் தேவையான நற்பண்புகள் இல்லாவிட்டால், அந்த இல்வாழ்க்கை வேறு எவ்வளவு சிறப்புகளைப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும் ஒரு பயனும் இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes that the core of a successful domestic life lies in the character and capability of the wife. The phrase 'மனைமாட்சி' refers to the specific virtues and skills required to manage a household excellently. If these qualities are absent in the wife, the family's life loses its meaning. Even if the household possesses every other kind of greatness or wealth, it ultimately amounts to nothing.

ai.literal: What is lacking, what, wife excellence if becomes? What exists, what, wife not-excellent when?
ai.translation: If a wife possesses excellence, what is lacking? If she lacks excellence, what is there?
ai.modern: மனைவி நற்பண்புடையவளாக இருந்தால் ஒருவனுக்கு இல்லாதது என்ன? அவள் நற்பண்பு இல்லாதவளாக இருந்தால் அவனிடம் இருப்பதுதான் என்ன?
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the central role of a wife's character in domestic life. The word 'illavaḷ' literally means 'she of the house', pointing to her foundational position. If she has 'māṇpu' (excellence or virtue), the household is complete and lacks nothing. Conversely, if she lacks this excellence ('māṇā kaṭai'), no amount of wealth or other possessions can make the household truly rich. The parallel structure contrasts 'illatu' (what is lacking) with 'uḷḷatu' (what exists) to show that her virtue is the ultimate measure of domestic wealth.

ai.literal: Than a woman, greatly worthy things what exist, fidelity called firmness to exist if obtained?
ai.translation: What is of greater worth than a woman, if she possesses the firmness known as fidelity?
ai.modern: கற்பு என்னும் மன உறுதி மட்டும் ஒரு பெண்ணிடம் இருக்குமானால், அவளை விடப் பெருமையுடையவை வேறு என்ன இருக்கின்றன?
ai.explanation: This couplet asks a rhetorical question to emphasize the supreme value of a woman's fidelity. The word 'கற்பு' refers to chastity or unwavering loyalty, which is described here as a form of 'திண்மை' or mental firmness. If a woman possesses this steadfast strength of character, there is nothing in the world more greatly worthy or precious than her.

ai.literal: God she worships not; husband having worshipped she who rises, 'rain' saying, will rain the rain.
ai.translation: If a wife who does not worship God, but wakes up worshipping her husband, commands it to rain, the rain will fall.
ai.modern: தெய்வத்தை வணங்காமல் தன் கணவனையே தொழுது துயிலெழும் மனைவி, பெய் என்று சொன்னால் மழையும் பெய்யும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet illustrates the immense moral power of a devoted wife. It states that a woman who directs her reverence entirely toward her husband rather than other deities possesses such virtue that nature itself obeys her. The phrase 'பெய்யெனப் பெய்யும்' shows that her steadfast loyalty grants her words the power to command the rain.

ai.literal: Herself having guarded, her husband having cherished, worthiness abounding word having guarded, weariness she who is without is a woman.
ai.translation: A true wife is one who guards herself, cherishes her husband, protects their honorable reputation, and never tires in these duties.
ai.modern: தன்னைக் காத்துக்கொண்டு, தன் கணவனையும் அன்போடு பேணி, பெருமை நிறைந்த புகழைக் காத்து, இந்த அறங்களில் சோர்வில்லாமல் இருப்பவளே சிறந்த பெண் ஆவாள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an ideal wife. She protects her own moral character and lovingly cares for the husband who married her. Furthermore, she guards the honorable reputation of their family without ever growing weary or slack in these responsibilities. The word 'சொல்' (word) here implies the good name or fame of the household, which she upholds through her steadfastness.

ai.literal: Confinement guarding protection what will do? Women's self-control guarding protection indeed foremost.
ai.translation: What good does the protection of physical confinement do? The protection of a woman's own self-control is the foremost guard.
ai.modern: பெண்களைச் சிறைவைத்து காக்கும் காவல் என்ன பயனைத் தரும்? அவர்கள் தங்களின் மன அடக்கத்தால் தம்மைக் காத்துக்கொள்ளும் காவலே மிகச் சிறந்ததாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet questions the effectiveness of guarding women through physical confinement or external restrictions. The word 'சிறை' refers to physical walls or imprisonment, while 'நிறை' denotes inner fullness, moral strength, or self-control. The text asserts that external guards achieve nothing of value. Instead, the true and foremost protection is the inner self-control that women maintain themselves.

ai.literal: If obtained, if they obtain, they will obtain, women, great glory, gods living world.
ai.translation: If women obtain the blessing of a devoted family life, they will attain great glory in the world where the gods live.
ai.modern: கணவனைப் போற்றும் சிறப்பினைப் பெண்கள் பெற்றால், அவர்கள் தேவர்கள் வாழும் உலகிலும் பெருஞ்சிறப்பைப் பெறுவார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet speaks of the ultimate reward for a devoted wife. The repeated conditional phrase 'பெற்றால் பெறின்' (if obtained, if they obtain) emphasizes fully embracing and fulfilling the role of a life partner. By doing so, women earn profound respect not just on earth, but great glory in the celestial world where the gods live.

ai.literal: Fame-securing wife to those who lack, there is not, scorners before, bull-like proud walk.
ai.translation: Those who lack a wife who secures a good name cannot walk with the proud, majestic gait of a bull before their detractors.
ai.modern: புகழைக் காக்கும் மனைவியைப் பெறாதவர்களுக்கு, தங்களை இகழ்ந்து பேசுபவர் முன்னே காளையைப் போலப் பெருமிதத்துடன் நடக்கும் நடை இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet describes the social confidence a person derives from their partner's good character. The word 'இல்' (il) primarily means house, but here it stands for the wife who manages the household. 'புகழ் புரிந்த' (pukaḻ purinta) refers to securing a good reputation for the family. Without such a partner, a person lacks the inner strength to face detractors. The image of the 'ஏறு' (bull) beautifully captures the proud, fearless bearing that comes from having a blameless and supportive home life.

ai.literal: Auspiciousness, they say, is household excellence; and its good ornament is obtaining good children.
ai.translation: They say the excellence of a wife is the true blessing of a household, and the gift of good children is its finest ornament.
ai.modern: மனைவியின் நற்பண்புகளே குடும்பத்திற்கு மங்கலம் என்று அறிஞர் கூறுவர்; நல்ல பிள்ளைகளைப் பெறுவதே அந்த மங்கலத்திற்குச் சிறந்த அணிகலன் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the true wealth of family life. The word 'மங்கலம்' refers to the auspiciousness or fundamental blessing of a home, which is identified as the noble character of the wife ('மனைமாட்சி'). Furthermore, the couplet states that the crowning ornament ('நன்கலம்') to this blessing is the gift of bearing good children ('நன்மக்கள்'). Together, a virtuous spouse and good children complete the joy and purpose of domestic life.
